services.desc: Enjoy Orange County with Balboa Fun Tours & Rentals. Ride electric bikes, kayaks, boats, and paddleboards for fun coastal adventures! Orange County’s coastline is one of Southern California’s greatest gifts, and Balboa Fun Tours & Rentals exists to help you make the most of it. We offer the largest combined fleet of water and land rentals in the area, with everything from electric boats and kayaks to electric bikes, beach cruisers, paddle boards, and guided Segway tours, all available from a single convenient base on the Balboa Peninsula.
